name: Brendan Englot
title: Anson Wood Burchard Endowed Professor; Interim Dean of the School of Computing

fitReason: Strong marine-autonomy and risk-aware learning agenda; physical AI evidence currently strongest for learned perception rather than executed RL control.

physicalEvidence.summary: March2026 opti-acoustic mapping study uses the lab’s heavy BlueROV2 with two Oculus imaging sonars, camera and navigation sensors in tank and marina deployments. YOLO11n-seg plus confidence-weighted Gaussian-process mapping are evaluated through real-time playback on a workstation. This is robot-collected learned-perception evidence, not closed-loop autonomous navigation. The separate2025 distributional-RL navigation paper is Gazebo simulation only.
